tools.description: Finding a concrete article from a part number or number fragment, e.g. `KH 14 B E` or `KH 14`. Also works for designation words but the full-text search (search_groups) is the better entry for those.
Look up a vault such as HLP by its address. Set include_followers for the depositor list.
Finding where a kind of part lives in the catalogue from a German description, e.g. `Kugelhahn`, `Steckverschraubung`. For part numbers use search_articles.
Trade and liquidation history for an address. Give start_time (unix ms) and optionally end_time; follow next_cursor as cursor. This is the only per-event liquidation record in the public API.
Autocomplete, or discovering the shop's vocabulary before a search_groups call.
